data.description:
FIGHT with any weapon you can find against different enemies in the Hex7 Arenas. 
DEFEND yourself with shield and sword and don't forget to RELOAD your guns once in awhile.
                                                                                                                                                                       
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-lhr8-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031640_1611492052972544_8434024045580790583_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=rubB8gMJbU4Q7kNvgFNQKZL&_nc_ht=scontent-lhr8-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBDFhTrtK1bv5oUzAtB42BRGRJrhbGP9wo8_WwrGxKkZQ&oe=670FB78C)
SURVIVE the first 7 ROUNDS.
Have FUN customizing your game as much as you like.
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-lhr6-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39035393_1502492917145105_2500292279720560247_n.png?_nc_cat=110&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=RU3S1Fbx2rkQ7kNvgFwScFs&_nc_ht=scontent-lhr6-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAddLhls8KsxQ9Q-Gux5Of8_5Zg5q4VN4u2OQ7ohUYuSw&oe=670FB59F)
EXPLORE the Arenas and enjoy the different game modes.
